description: Key Features: Custom filter sorting: Sorting can be decided by another measure so that items in the dropdown appear based on the measure value, following a predefined initial item. Top N functionality: This feature allows users to utilize the Top N element feature without needing to create a measure. Top Fixed Element: Users can fix specific elements to always display at the top. Dropdown item count control: The number of items in the dropdown can be fixed based on a measure value. For example, selecting the top 5 items, while the rest appear under a combined "Other Category". This category is expandable, so when users click the "+" symbol, smaller items become visible, allowing individual item filtering. Inactive dropdown/slicer: The slicer or dropdown will appear greyed out when there are no values to display. To learn more about the license and pricing, please click on the Office Solution logo.
